title: Didn't perform well
text: Didn't perform well. It didn't hold any vegetable very well from a tomato to an onion.  I couldn't get even cuts and I didn't like dulling my knife when I cut down to the bottom.  Not at all was I was hoping for and haven't found another use for it yet.
